label: Soft Edges
blurb: Feathers the edge of the picture away to nothing so it sits on whatever is behind it without a hard border, the way the soft edges setting does to a picture on a slide. The feather can follow the rectangle of the frame, a rectangle with rounded corners, or an oval drawn inside it, and you set how far in from the edge it reaches and how quickly it falls away, from a gentle haze to a crisp vignette of transparency. It takes the alpha down rather than painting the edge a colour, so anything layered underneath shows through properly.
